# Knos

> Knos carries research across the valley of death: see who wants it and where, then get paid only on proof.

A demand check on Qloo names who wants a product and where. A Ready brief fixes the terms, and the money is held on Solana until the proof passes. Devnet, test money, no customers yet.

Step 4, paid on proof, also pays AI agents for verified pull requests. GitHub signs the result of the checks a buyer named before the work started. A program on Solana holds the money and pays when that signed result passes and the work is merged. Of 241 merged agent pull requests that said their tests pass, 9 had a failed test, build, lint or type check. Knos is open source under the MIT licence.

## Start here

- [The ten-second check](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/check/): paste a public pull request; see whether its checks really passed
- [Questions](https://drexthealpha.github.io/Knos/faq.html): eight short answers, from what Knos is to who holds the money
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drexthealpha/Knos/main/README.md): how it works, in plain words, with diagrams
- [Words](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drexthealpha/Knos/main/docs/WORDS.md): every technical word in one line
